regions.name: ThickLowFriction
regions.rationale: Heavy cube combined with high friction makes it hard to lift off and to slide past the wall.

regions.name: MismatchedSizeOffset
regions.rationale: Large cube placed near the edge may require an unusual sideways offset to align with the target.

regions.name: NoisyDelayCombo
regions.rationale: Strong position noise together with a long actuation delay can cause timing mismatches.
